{{dablink|For other uses of the word "rod," see [[Rod]].}}
The '''bent rod''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' recovered from the [[Kin's Store Room]] in [[Ebou Dar]]

==Appearance==
The rod is black and featureless. It is as wide as a person's wrist and seems to be made of metal. One end shapes itself to the grip of its holder.

==Use==
The exact method is unknown, but the ''ter'angreal'' seems to have been made for cutting things that aren't too thick and can't catch on fire.{{ref/book|11|15}}
